title: Lock Museum of America

services.name: Escape Room
services.desc: Games resume in May 2026. You can start reserving games in April 2026. Until then, be "safe"! The Lock Museum Adventure takes place in the Lock Museum of America, which houses the largest collection of locks and keys in the United States, and quite possibly, the world. The Museum is in Terryville, CT, on the site of the former headquarters of the Eagle Lock Company. You will use puzzles, riddles, and codes to open locks and antique safes to solve a mystery.
